_note: CV conventions by country. Source to extend: https://www.visualcv.com/international/

US.privacy_notes: No photo, DOB, marital status, or nationality — discrimination-law liability.

IN.privacy_notes: Photo optional; DOB common but not required. Naukri profiles often include more personal detail.

DE.privacy_notes: Photo + personal details customary; often signed/dated. Tabular reverse-chron.

AE.privacy_notes: GCC: photo + nationality + visa status commonly expected.
